coordinates: Original 1280x720 pixels; x increases right, y increases down.
limits: An axis-aligned envelope can contain background or another object's projected point.
Perspective, adjoining surfaces, occlusion and 2px image blur can create legitimate contacts.
Unavailable 0 0 0 corners are excluded; no location is invented.
Raw counts are diagnostic workload, not annotation-error rates or model precision.

method.action: Review priorities only. Never move a box from geometry alone.
method.edge_contact: Foreign locatable point within +/-2px of an edge and within the other axis span expanded by 2px; record each qualifying edge.
method.inputs: All 507 current R48 supplementary TXT rows, with exact stable IDs; no predictions used.
method.lower_gap: Retain R28 criterion: ymax-max(locatable lower-corner y) > max(5px,0.25*box height).
method.ranking: Own-corner violation, then strict foreign interior, then large lower gap, then ordinary edge contact; retain separate counts.
method.strict_interior: Retain R28 criterion: foreign locatable point >2px inside all four edges.
method.upper_gap: No zero upper-gap constraint: lower-front landmarks naturally lie below the top boundary.
